instructions: Complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

items.prompt: The team knew that, if the reading worked, the grains would count among the earliest samples of (19) ........ ever obtained from an archaeological find.
items.evidence: Success would place the wheat among the oldest plant DNA ever recovered and analysed, and would let the researchers compare it precisely with modern wheat species rather than relying on the shape of the grain alone, which can be an unreliable guide to a plant's genetic identity.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says that if the work succeeds, the wheat would rank among the oldest plant DNA ever obtained; so the answer is 'plant DNA'.

items.prompt: So that no modern genetic material could reach the ancient samples, the work was split between two (20) ........ , one in Britain and one in Turkey.
items.evidence: To avoid contaminating the ancient samples with modern DNA, the extraction and analysis were carried out in two physically separate laboratories, one at the University of Manchester in the United Kingdom and the other at Middle East Technical University in Turkey.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the work was carried out in two physically separate laboratories to avoid contamination by modern DNA; since the word limit is two, the answer is 'separate laboratories'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı (3 turda da 'laboratories' verdi, gerçek cevap 'separate laboratories').
items.review_note: E10 anlam duzeyi olcumunden gelen isaret. Duzeltilmesi de mumkun degil, cunku boslugun bas adi cumlenin anlamsal rolunden zorunlu olarak cikiyor: eski DNA'nin cikarilip cozumlendigi yer soruldugunda bas ad zorunlu olarak laboratuvar olur. items.prompt: A stretch of genetic material carried only by six-chromosome wheat, known as the (21) ........ , turned up in grains that shape alone had put down as einkorn and emmer.
items.evidence: From these samples the team recovered thirty-two DNA sequences in total, and among them were fragments containing the so-called D genome, a segment of genetic material found only in hexaploid wheat.
items.explanation: Paragraph E names the genetic segment found only in six-chromosome-set (hexaploid) wheat as the 'D genome'; so the answer is 'D genome'.
items.flag_reason: Cevap 'D genome', alti kromozomlu (hexaploid) bugdaya ozgu genetik bolgenin bugday genetiginde yerlesik adi olan 'D genome' terimiyle bilinmesi sayesinde parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.

items.prompt: By the usual account, the growing of einkorn began in the (22) ........ area in the south of Turkey.
items.evidence: Simple wheat domestication is usually traced to the Fertile Crescent around twelve thousand years ago, with the region of Karacadağ in southern Turkey generally credited as the birthplace of einkorn cultivation specifically.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says that the region of Karacadağ in southern Turkey is generally credited as the birthplace of einkorn cultivation; so the answer is 'Karacadağ'.
items.flag_reason: Cevap 'Karacadag', einkorn bugdayinin ekiminin dogdugu yer olarak arkeolojide anilan, guney Turkiye'deki bilinen bir bolge adi; bu genel bilgiyle bosluk parcaya bakmadan da doldurulabiliyor.
